message.content:
**Winner:** Alex

**Explanation**

In Texas Hold’em each player’s best hand is made from the two hole cards plus the five community cards.  
Since no community cards were supplied, we can only compare the two‑card “hole” hands themselves.

| Player | Hole Cards | Highest Card |
|--------|------------|--------------|
| Alex   | A♠ K♠      | Ace (A)      |
| Sam    | 2♦ 3♣      | 3            |
| Robert | Q♥ 10♥     | Queen (Q)    |
| Steve  | 4♠ 5♠      | 5            |

With only two cards, the hand ranking reduces to the highest card (no pairs, flushes, etc.).  
Alex’s Ace‑high hand beats all others, so Alex is the winner.
